bonuses.description: Increases damage and healing done by magical spells and effects by up to 18.
Decreases the magical resistances of your spell targets by 10.
Decreases the threat generated by your spells by 15%.
Health or Mana gained from Drain Life and Drain Mana increased by 15%.
Your pet gains 15 stamina and 100 spell resistance against all schools of magic.
Mana cost of Shadow spells reduced by 15%.
-0.1 sec to the casting time of your Flash Heal spell.
Improves your chance to get a critical strike with spells by 2%.
Increases your chance of a critical hit with Prayer of Healing by 25%.
Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish ability by 30 sec.
Increases your maximum Energy by 10.
Heals the rogue for 500 when Vanish is performed.
Damage dealt by Thorns increased by 4 and duration increased by 50%.
Improves your chance to get a critical strike with spells by 2%.
Reduces the cooldown of your Tranquility and Hurricane spells by 50%.
The radius of your totems that affect friendly targets is increased to 30 yd.
After casting your Healing Wave or Lesser Healing Wave spell, gives you a 25% chance to gain Mana equal to 35% of the base cost of the spell.
Your Healing Wave will now jump to additional nearby targets. Each jump reduces the effectiveness of the heal by 80%, and the spell will jump to up to two additional targets.
Increases the range of your Mend Pet spell by 50% and the effect by 10%.  Also reduces the cost by 30%.
Increases your pet's stamina by 30 and all spell resistances by 40.
Increases the damage of Multi-shot and Volley by 15%.
Increases the chance of triggering a Judgement of Light heal by 10%.
Improves your chance to get a critical strike with spells by 1%.
Improves your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by 1%.
Gives the Paladin a chance on every melee hit to heal your party for 200.
Increases the block value of your shield by 30.
Gives you a 20% chance to generate an additional Rage point whenever damage is dealt to you.
Increases the threat generated by Sunder Armor by 15%.
